# DigiVerse (digiverse.top)

> DigiVerse is a digital commerce marketplace for verified software license keys, operating systems, productivity suites, and Muse AI tokens with 0-second instant delivery and zero-fee multi-chain cryptocurrency checkout.

## Overview & Core Identity
- **Website**: https://digiverse.top
- **Type**: Digital Goods & Software License Reseller
- **Primary Offerings**: Genuine Microsoft Windows licenses, Microsoft Office suites, productivity software, and Meta Muse AI tokens.
- **Delivery Guarantee**: Instant 0-second automated delivery for stock items, real-time automated delivery for Muse AI tokens.
- **Payment Infrastructure**: Multi-chain EVM cryptocurrency verification (USDT and USDC) with zero payment gateway fees, plus on-site wallet balance.
- **Customer Support**: Integrated support ticketing system and 24/7 Telegram community channel (https://t.me/digiverse_top).

## Key Product Offerings
- **Operating Systems**: Genuine OEM & Retail licenses for Windows 11 Professional, Windows 10 Professional, Windows 11 Home, and Windows Server.
- **Productivity Software**: Microsoft Office Professional Plus, Project, Visio, and digital utility licenses.
- **Muse AI Tokens**: 1 Billion Meta Muse AI Tokens delivered directly to user accounts via account invite link/code with automated status polling.

## Payment Methods & Multi-Chain Crypto Rails
DigiVerse uses an on-chain, non-custodial transaction verification engine:
- **BNB Smart Chain (BEP20)**: USDT (Tether USD)
- **Polygon PoS**: USDT & USDC (PoS)
- **Base (Coinbase L2)**: USDT & USDC
- **On-Site Wallet**: Customers can top up their DigiVerse wallet balance via crypto deposit and pay instantly with 1-click checkout.
- **Single Deposit Address**: Users send to a verified company EVM address across any supported network; the system automatically detects incoming transactions on-chain.

## Delivery Speed & Fulfillment
- **Stock License Keys (`digitrust`, `internal`)**: Serial numbers and activation guides are delivered in 0 seconds directly on screen and permanently archived in the user's account under `/account/orders`.
- **Muse AI Tokens**: Processed asynchronously via direct API and invite fulfillment, with live status updates accessible via `/api/orders/buff-status`.
- **Manual Delivery**: Custom enterprise or specialized digital items delivered within 1 to 24 hours with email notification.

## Referral & Free Gift Box Rewards
- **Referral Rewards**: Registered users earn free gift reward boxes for inviting customers.
- **0-Second Instant Unlock**: Reward boxes have zero lock delay (`lock_delay_seconds = 0`) and can be claimed immediately upon qualification.
- **Reward Value**: 1 Gift Box = 1 Billion Muse AI Tokens.
- **Seamless 1-Click Claim**: Navigating to `/?product=-12` automatically applies an available gift box for an instant $0.00 checkout.

## Customer Warranty & Guarantee
- **100% Genuine Activation Guarantee**: Every license key sold is guaranteed to activate online.
- **Automatic Refunds**: In the event an order cannot be completed, funds are automatically refunded to the customer's on-site wallet balance immediately.
- **Support Tickets**: Full ticket inbox available at `/account/support`.
